scientific_question: Does the CAGE-v3 improvement over original CAGE and matched KIVI observed on Qwen3-8B transfer to Llama-2-7B without Llama-specific metric tuning?

protocol_deviation_disclosure.justification: The frozen candidate showed material gains over original CAGE and matched KIVI plus a 2.099 percent packed-memory reduction versus original CAGE, while failing only the separate Kitty-Pro all-length noninferiority gate. Cross-architecture transfer of the former effect is a distinct scientific question.
protocol_deviation_disclosure.forbidden_claim: This follow-up cannot be described as a preregistered pass of the original Qwen3 promotion gate or as evidence that CAGE-v3 beats Kitty-Pro on Qwen3.

source_candidate.key_refinement: prompt-adaptive sparse symmetric INT2 residual on frozen per-layer channel counts
source_candidate.value_policy: uniform symmetric INT2; no Value adaptivity

architecture_normalization.head_dim_requirement: Llama head_dim must equal the frozen Qwen3 head_dim of 128
architecture_normalization.per_kv_head_rule: Apply the same channel count independently to every target KV head; do not scale channel count by the 8-to-32 KV-head ratio.

layer_score_transfer.source_score: frozen Qwen3 sink32 calibration layer score for the same prompt length
layer_score_transfer.target_layer_center: u_j = (j + 0.5) / 32 for target layer j in [0,31]
layer_score_transfer.ranking: descending mapped score with smaller target layer index as the deterministic tie break

architecture_normalization.residual_length_transfer: retain the frozen Qwen3 residual length independently at 1024, 2048, and 4032 tokens

input_and_scoring.corpus: the exact frozen Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-2-raw-v1 test token stream already used by the Llama-2 paired-PPL experiment
input_and_scoring.anchor_rule: reuse the exact frozen 50 interior-51sts anchors
input_and_scoring.primary_metric: cache-conditioned teacher-forced continuation mean NLL over exactly 64 target tokens

method_roles.byte_only_selection: CPU-only packed-byte selection from the exact grids below before any Llama-v3 metric; minimize absolute byte difference at each length, then prefer the lower-byte point, then lexicographic point ID
method_roles.kivi_feasibility_boundary: KIVI remains symmetric INT2 with supported group sizes and residual divisibility. If no legal KIVI point is within the CAGE-v1 tolerance, retain the closest legal point, require that it uses at least the candidate bytes, report the exact memory surplus, and do not call the comparison equal-memory.
method_roles.kitty_pro_role: secondary external transfer track only after a separate non-official Llama port fidelity protocol; not part of the primary transfer gate

frozen_packed_memory_preflight.representation: complete active logical packed paper estimate; not realized CUDA allocation
frozen_packed_memory_preflight.candidate_formula: all-channel INT2 K/V backbone plus frozen sparse INT2 Key refinement, one byte per persistent refinement-channel index, 32-token FP16 sink, and frozen per-length residual

kivi_grid.residual_length_rule: positive multiples of group_size at most 512

frozen_packed_memory_preflight.selection_rule: minimize absolute model-wide packed-byte difference from the candidate independently at each prompt length, then prefer lower packed bytes, then lexicographic point_id

primary_transfer_gate.cage_v1_pass_rule: overall relative PPL at most -1.0 percent, NLL-delta CI95 upper bound below zero, every length relative PPL at most +0.5 percent, and closest CAGE-v1 packed-byte difference within 0.25 percent
primary_transfer_gate.kivi_pass_rule: overall relative PPL at most -1.0 percent, NLL-delta CI95 upper bound below zero, every length relative PPL at most +0.5 percent, candidate packed bytes no greater than closest legal KIVI at every length, and exact memory surplus reported

statistics.anchor_windows: the 50 deterministic interior-51sts windows are nonoverlapping at the frozen token count and retain all methods and lengths within each resampled anchor
statistics.overall_bootstrap: resample the 50 anchors with replacement and retain all methods, prompt lengths, and 64 target tokens from each selected anchor
statistics.per_length_bootstrap: resample the same 50 paired anchors independently for each prompt length
statistics.inference_scope: deterministic protocol-level uncertainty on one concatenated WikiText-2 test stream; not document-clustered or population-level significance

outputs: packed-memory candidate and frozen comparison grids

reporting_and_boundaries.memory_representation: complete logical packed paper estimate only
reporting_and_boundaries.if_primary_gate_passes: CAGE-v3 may be considered a cross-architecture successor to original CAGE, subject to complete reporting and a separately frozen paper-integration decision.
reporting_and_boundaries.if_primary_gate_fails: Retain original CAGE as the paper method and close this transfer study without target-specific tuning.
